description: This PHP source file defines the 'Event' class within the Opencart Admin Controller Startup namespace. The class manages registration of events dynamically loaded from the database during application startup. It extends the base Controller class and contains an 'index' method that loads event configurations, iterates over them, and registers active events based on their triggers and actions.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: The Event class manages dynamic registration of system events during startup, based on configurations stored in the database. It extends the base Controller class and provides an index method to handle event setup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads event configurations from the database, and for each active event, registers it with the system by parsing its trigger and associating it with the corresponding actions.
